info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Cross Channel Transaction Authorization-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Transaction Authorization API facilitates the authorization of transactions across various banking channels. This API enables financial institutions to manage and verify authorization requests efficiently, ensuring secure and prompt processing. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial services providers seeking to enhance transaction security for their users. The API supports operations that allow for seamless integration and validation, thus improving overall transaction handling and customer trust.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to authorize a transaction that affects multiple channels, ensuring that the transaction is validated and approved before processing. It facilitates secure and seamless transactions across different platforms.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to authorize a cross-channel transaction. It must adhere to the structure defined in the schema, which includes all necessary parameters and data types required for transaction authorization.
